 where r.SOURCE_DOC_TYPE='PICK_WAVE' and r.RESERVATION_KIND='HARD' and r.STATUS in('ACTIVE','ALLOCATED','PICKING')and r.BASE_QTY>0 and r.BASE_UOM='EA'and(r.ARTICUL like 'Q%'or r.UID_PALLET like 'FULL.QA:%')

select c.CASE_PICK_TASK_ID,c.WARE_ID,c.ASSIGNED_TO,c.SSCC,c.PALLET_TYPE_ID,c.CONTENT_VERSION,c.PICKED_QTY,
 l.CASE_PICK_LINE_ID,l.ARTICUL,l.CELL_CODE,l.PLANNED_QTY,nvl(l.PICKED_QTY,0) LINE_PICKED_QTY,w.PICK_WAVE_ID,
 (select count(*)from RRL_STOCK_RESERVATION r where r.PICK_TASK_ID=l.PICK_TASK_ID and r.ARTICUL=l.ARTICUL and r.BASE_UOM='EA' and r.STATUS in('ACTIVE','ALLOCATED','PICKING')and r.RESERVATION_KIND='HARD') EA_RESERVATIONS
 from RRL_CASE_PICK_TASK c join RRL_CASE_PICK_LINE l on l.CASE_PICK_TASK_ID=c.CASE_PICK_TASK_ID

 order by c.CASE_PICK_TASK_ID desc fetch first 15 rows only

 from RRL_CASE_PICK_TASK c join RRL_CASE_PICK_LINE l on l.CASE_PICK_TASK_ID=c.CASE_PICK_TASK_ID

 order by c.CASE_PICK_TASK_ID desc fetch first 15 rows only
